text_block_list.text:
With Маяно Топ Ган's debut
approaching, we
try various training
methods.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Being the genius she is, she's able to
master new
tactics and movements one
after the other.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I rack my brain trying to
find ways
to challenge her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
